column4: Schedule the automatic extraction of the production register
column6:
As a Production Reconciliation Handler, I need booked accounts extracted per insurer automatically on the defined frequency, on the next working day after a holiday, so that every insurer's register is ready without manual work.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: PRCID.001 (p.142)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Production Reconciliation, FR-OP-070 Schedule the automatic extraction of the production register
* Persona: Recon Handler (schedules); System (the scheduled register extraction)
* Function: Each insurer has a schedule with its frequency (monthly on a day of the month, or weekly on a weekday), whether the register is sent automatically, and the recipients. the scheduled register extraction (daily 09:00 PHT) extracts the booked accounts of every insurer due that day. A run date that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day of the head office calendar.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Frequency per insurer (values from BDOI, OQ29). (Configurable)
* (R2) Holidays roll to the next working day. (Fixed)
* Check: No company or insurer. Message: "Choose the company and the insurer of the schedule"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has RECON_PROCESS to maintain schedules, when the handler adds a schedule for an insurer, then a monthly schedule on day 5 extracts on 5 October; when 5 October is a holiday it extracts on the next working day.

*Out of scope / notes*
* No open clarification on this FR.

* Screens: Extract Schedules
* Test cases: TC-OP-070.1, TC-OP-070.2 (2 conditions, 2 cases)

column4: Extract the production register manually and view it
column6:
As a Production Reconciliation Handler, I need to see the file location, date and time of each extract, so that I know which register was produced when.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: PRCID.005 (p.143); PRCID.011 (p.144); PRCID.012 (p.145); PRCID.013 (p.145); PRCID.020 (p.146); PRCID.034 (p.149)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Production Reconciliation, FR-OP-071 Extract the production register manually and view it
* Persona: Recon Handler
* Function: The handler extracts the register of an insurer for a booking period (PRX-yyyy-n). Each line records the ledger facts of the booked account, the last payment and the estimated flag; an account not on an earlier register of the cycle counts as new. The extract shows its file name, location in the list of extracts (folder PRODRECON/<insurer>), date and time, creator and row count.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only accounts booked in the selected period are extracted. (Fixed)
* Check: Period end before start. Message: "The booking period ends before it starts"
* Check: Nothing booked. Message: "No invoice was booked with <insurer> from <from> to <to>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has RECON_PROCESS and a manual extract of INS-MGIC for September, when the handler clicks New Extract and enters the insurer and booking period (or production month), then it lists only accounts booked in September.
* (AC2) Given the user has RECON_PROCESS, when the handler clicks New Extract and enters the insurer and booking period (or production month), then the extract shows its file name, date, time and row count, and PRC-EXTRACT-LOG shows the same count.

*Out of scope / notes*

column4: Produce the register file in the agreed layout
column6:
As a Production Reconciliation Handler, I need the extracted file locked except for the insurer's remarks column, so that the insurer can answer without changing BDOI's data.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: PRCID.002 (p.142); PRCID.004 (p.142-143); PRCID.006 (p.143); PRCID.007 (p.143)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Production Reconciliation, FR-OP-072 Produce the register file in the agreed layout
* Persona: System
* Function: The register is an XLSX workbook in the Production Register layout of Annex IV #5: month of production, insurer, invoice number, booking, inception and expiry dates, policy number, endorsement number, PN number, assured name, insurance code, risk type, basic premium, gross commission, A/R client, gross premium, booked VAT, amount paid, date paid, OR number, adjustment type, remittance status.

*Business rules*
* (R1) File name pattern, default <INSURER>_PRODREG_<yyyyMM>_<seq>. (Configurable)
* (R2) Template per insurer when needed (OQ29). (Configurable)
* (R3) Password convention to be confirmed (BRD-1 Q07); a password per e-mail until then. (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given an extract exists, when BIBS creates the workbook from the extract lines, then in the downloaded register every column except Remarks and Incentive is locked.
* (AC2) Given an extract exists and two extracts of the same insurer and month, when BIBS creates the workbook from the extract lines, then they get different file names.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-OP-16 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Insurer register columns (PRCID.002; FR-OP-072). Proposed: The Remarks and Incentive columns and 200 blank rows are editable, so the insurer can add unbooked production. Decision requested: Confirm the editable columns.

column4: Match booked and insurer lines within tolerance
column6:
As a Production Reconciliation Handler, I need pre-booked or unbooked accounts matched automatically on booking or upload, so that matches are made without waiting for me.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: PRCID.024 (p.147); PRCID.025 (p.147); PRCID.026 (p.147; annex p.24-25); PRCID.027 (p.147-148); PRCID.030 (p.148)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Production Reconciliation, FR-OP-075 Match booked and insurer lines within tolerance
* Persona: System; Recon Handler (re-match)
* Function: BIBS pairs each insurer line with a booked line using the keys of RECON_MATCH_KEYS in order (default invoice number, then policy number). It then compares the fields: policy, reference / invoice and PN numbers and the policy period must be equal; the assured name is compared ignoring case and spacing; commission, basic premium and gross premium match when they differ by 1.00 peso equivalent or less, whichever side is higher.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Tolerance 1.00 peso equivalent per amount field; foreign currency differences converted to pesos first. (Configurable)
* (R4) Rate of the peso conversion: BOOK rate of the booking date of the invoice (proposed, CLR-OP-49). (Configurable)
* (R2) Match keys and order. (Configurable)
* (R3) Automatch schedule manual until BDOI gives the frequency. (Configurable)
* Check: Action on a closed cycle. Message: "Cycle <no> is closed"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a cycle has extract lines and insurer lines and a gross premium difference of 0.80, when BIBS pairs the lines by key, then it is MATCHED; a difference of 1.20 is MATCHED_WITH_DISCREPANCY listing gross premium.
* (AC2) Given a cycle has extract lines and insurer lines, when BIBS pairs the lines by key, then on a USD account with a BOOK rate of 58.00, a difference of USD 0.01 (PHP 0.58) is MATCHED and a difference of USD 0.02 (PHP 1.16) is MATCHED_WITH_DISCREPANCY.
* (AC3) Given a cycle has extract lines and insurer lines and an account the insurer did not return, when BIBS pairs the lines by key, then it is BDOI_ONLY.
* (AC4) Given a cycle has extract lines and insurer lines, when BIBS pairs the lines by key, then booking the invoice of a waiting insurer-only line matches it automatically.

* CLR-OP-26 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Match keys and automatch frequency (PRCID.024-027; FR-OP-075). Proposed: Lines are matched on the match keys of the reconciliation parameters in order (by default the invoice number, then the policy number); the automatch runs on every upload and when the handler clicks Match Again. Decision requested: Give the match keys and the automatch frequency (OQ30).
* CLR-OP-49 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Peso-equivalent tolerance (PRCID.026; FR-OP-075). Proposed: The difference of a foreign currency account is converted to pesos at the BOOK rate of the booking date of the invoice before the 1.00 tolerance is applied. Decision requested: Confirm the rate and the date of the conversion.
* CLR-OP-50 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Reconciliation statuses (PRCID.022, 030; FR-OP-074, 075). Proposed: Matched and Matched with Discrepancy as in the annex; the annex status Unmatched is shown as three kinds: BDOI Only, Unmatched - Pre-booked and Unmatched - No Booking. column4: Check the early remittance incentive applied by insurers
column6:
As a Remittance Processor, I need BIBS to validate the eligibility of qualified CLG / CBG motor and fire accounts and compute the early remittance incentive as a separate calculation, so that the incentive is applied only when earned and never merged with the commission or remittance values.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: RMTID.041 (annex p.16-17)
* FRS: FRS BRD-02 Operations v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-02_Operations_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Production Reconciliation, FR-OP-078 Check the early remittance incentive applied by insurers
* Persona: Recon Handler
* Function: For each booked account of the cycle, BIBS checks the remittance date against the insurer's incentive rate and window kept by Remittance (FR-OP-038), so that the handler can compare the incentive the insurer applied with the one Remittance computed. The account is ELIGIBLE when remitted within the window (30 days for CLG / CBG motor and fire at 2% in the BRD example), NOT_ELIGIBLE when remitted late, and NO_RULE when no rule covers it. The check reads the Remittance computation and never computes a second incentive.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Rates and windows come from the Remittance incentive rules (OQ23). (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the cycle has booked accounts, when the handler opens the Early Incentive tab, then an account remitted 20 days after inception under a 30-day rule is ELIGIBLE at the rule's rate.
* (AC2) Given the cycle has booked accounts and an account of an insurer without rule, when the handler opens the Early Incentive tab, then it is NO_RULE.

column4: Apply the minimal balance threshold
column6:
As a Collection Handler, I need only the invoices above the minimal balance threshold listed, so that I do not chase immaterial balances.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.005 (p.28 / 49); BRCLXN.008 (p.28 / 49); BRCLXN.009 (p.28 / 49)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.2 Outstanding PR worklist, FR-CL-011 Apply the minimal balance threshold
* Persona: System
* Function: An invoice enters the worklist as OPEN when its total to collect (the six PR components plus PR2307) is above CLX_MIN_BALANCE_THRESHOLD. At or below the threshold, a new invoice is not listed and a listed account moves to COMPLETED. A completed account reopens when its balance comes back above the threshold (for example after a payment reversal).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Included when the total to collect is above the threshold (strictly greater). (Fixed)
* (R2) Excluded when the total is zero or at or below the threshold; the account is not deleted (FR-CL-018). (Fixed)
* (R3) Threshold CLX_MIN_BALANCE_THRESHOLD, default 10.00, in the invoice currency; the value is to be confirmed (CQ03). (Configurable)
* (R4) The Collections threshold is separate from the Cashiering minimal-balance write-off rule (MIN_BALANCE_AUTO_MAX, OQ11). (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the threshold parameter exists (default 10.00) and the threshold at 10.00, when the refresh reads the total to collect of each invoice, then an invoice with 10.01 outstanding is listed and one with 10.00 is not.
* (AC2) Given the threshold parameter exists (default 10.00) and a listed account paid down to 8.00, when the refresh reads the total to collect of each invoice, then it moves to Completed Collections at the next refresh.

* Function: The job CLX_DAILY_REFRESH runs every night at 22:15 (Manila), after the 22:00 end-of-day. * (AC1) Given the invoice ledger holds the booked invoices and an invoice booked during the day, when at 22:15 the job reads the ledger invoices of each company, then it is on the worklist the next morning.
* (AC2) Given the invoice ledger holds the booked invoices and a payment applied at 10:00, when at 22:15 the job reads the ledger invoices of each company, then it reduces the account's outstanding before 10:05.
* (AC3) Given the invoice ledger holds the booked invoices and a failed run, when at 22:15 the job reads the ledger invoices of each company, then it raises CLX_REFRESH_FAILED and is visible in the job run history.

column4: Create installment plans for multi-year and installment accounts
column6:
As a Collection Handler, I need to monitor installment-based premiums per due date, so that missed or delayed payments are detected and acted upon promptly.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.053 (p.19-20); Minutes of 27-Apr-2026 on BRD 53 (p.1-2)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Installments, promises and account views, FR-CL-040 Create installment plans for multi-year and installment accounts
* Persona: Collection Handler; Collection / Marketing Team Lead; Section Head
* Function: An installment plan gives the due dates and amounts an account is followed up on. It has one of three bases. POLICY_YEARS takes every policy-year invoice of a multi-year account (booked, or still scheduled in booking) and splits each year into the cycles of the billing frequency within its coverage year. GENERATED splits the outstanding of one invoice into N equal installments from a first due date. MANUAL takes installments entered by the user, which must add up to the outstanding.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One live plan per invoice and per policy-year account. (Fixed)
* (R2) Billing frequencies Annual, Semi-annual, Quarterly, Monthly. (Configurable)
* (R3) At most 120 installments in one plan. (Fixed)
* (R4) Installment terms are entered in Collections. The minutes record that schedules are kept in Excel or offline files today, that the requirement does not depend on a source system and that the integration approach is decided in design; the proposal is plans made in BIBS, with a one-time load of the current schedules through the data migration (CQ15; CLR-CL-12). (Fixed)
* Check: Account without a booked policy year. Message: "Account <ARN> has no booked policy year"
* Check: Invoice with nothing outstanding. Message: "Invoice <no> has no outstanding premium to schedule"
* Check: Invoice paid directly or cancelled. Message: "Invoice <no> is paid directly to the insurer / cancelled and has no premium to collect"
* Check: Invoice not in the ledger. Message: "Invoice <no> is not in the ledger"
* Check: Live plan exists. Message: "Plan <no> already schedules this account; cancel it first"
* Check: No installment entered. Message: "Enter at least one installment"
* Check: Manual amounts or dates invalid. Message: "Installment amounts must be positive and due dates increasing"
* Check: Manual total differs from the outstanding. Message: "The installments add up to <sum> but the outstanding premium is <amount>"
* Check: Frequency without a cycle length. Message: "Billing frequency <code> has no cycle length defined"
* Check: Cancel a plan that is not active. Message: "Plan <no> is <status> and cannot be cancelled"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CLX_BILLING and the account or invoice has premium to collect (not paid directly to the insurer, not cancelled) and a three-year account booked with annual policy-year invoices and a quarterly frequency, when the user clicks New Installment Plan and chooses the plan basis, then it gets a plan of 12 installments, four per coverage year.
* (AC2) Given the user has CLX_BILLING and the account or invoice has premium to collect (not paid directly to the insurer, not cancelled) and a generated plan of 4 installments on an outstanding of 40,000.00, when the user clicks New Installment Plan and chooses the plan basis, then it has four installments of 10,000.00.
* (AC3) Given the user has CLX_BILLING and the account or invoice has premium to collect (not paid directly to the insurer, not cancelled) and a second live plan on the same invoice, when the user clicks New Installment Plan and chooses the plan basis, then it is refused with CLX_PLAN_EXISTS.
* (AC4) Given the user has CLX_BILLING and the account or invoice has premium to collect (not paid directly to the insurer, not cancelled) and an unpaid installment past its due date, when the user clicks New Installment Plan and chooses the plan basis, then it is flagged overdue and listed on Installments Due.

Proposed: Plans are made in Collections (policy years, generated or manual); installment terms do not come from the quotation or the account. The schedules kept in Excel today are loaded once through the data migration. Decision requested: Confirm plans made in Collections with a one-time load of the current schedules, or name the system that keeps the schedules (CQ15).
* CLR-CL-32 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Billing statements generated by Operations (BRCLXN.058, 060; FR-CL-060 to 062; WT-D). Proposed: The Operations billing user, with the new permission CLX_SOA_ISSUE, runs the billing, generates, sends and cancels the statements; the proposed holder is the Cashiering Team Leader / Head, an existing Operations profile. The Collection Handlers and Team Leads see the statements, their lines and e-mails and download the PDF, read only; they keep the installment plans (FR-CL-040). In the screenshots of WT-D steps 2 to 4 and of the Billing Statements and Statement of Account screens the statement is generated and sent by the seed user Clara Collection Handler; under this rule the Operations billing user does these steps and is shown as Generated By. Decision requested: Confirm that Operations generates and sends the statements and name the existing Operations profile that holds CLX_SOA_ISSUE (proposed: the Cashiering Team Leader / Head); confirm that the Collections roles only view them; provide the sample SOA annex (CQ18).

column4: Record and evaluate promises to pay
column6:
As a Collection Team Lead, I need broken payment promises detected per installment, so that the escalation can be triggered.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.055 (p.20); BRCLXN.053 (p.19-20)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.5 Installments, promises and account views, FR-CL-042 Record and evaluate promises to pay
* Persona: Collection user; System (promise check)
* Function: The handler records the client's promise to pay an invoice, or one installment of it - the day the promise was made, the promised payment date and the amount (blank = the whole outstanding). A new promise on the same invoice replaces the running one.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The day of the promise cannot be in the future; the promised date cannot be before it. (Fixed)
* (R2) The promised amount is positive and at most the outstanding. (Fixed)
* (R3) Grace days CLX_PROMISE_GRACE_DAYS, default 0 (0-30); the kept / broken rule is to be confirmed (CQ16). (Configurable)
* (R4) Schedule 22:45 Manila daily. (Configurable)
* Check: Promised date missing or day of promise in the future. Message: "Enter the promised date; the day of the promise cannot be in the future"
* Check: Promised date before the day of the promise. Message: "The promised date cannot be before the day of the promise"
* Check: Amount not positive. Message: "The promised amount must be positive"
* Check: Amount above the outstanding. Message: "The promised amount <amount> is above the outstanding <outstanding>"
* Check: Nothing to collect. Message: "Invoice <no> has nothing to collect"
* Check: Installment of another invoice. Message: "The installment does not bill invoice <no>"
* Check: Withdraw a closed promise. Message: "The promise of <invoice> is already <status>"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CLX_WORK; several invoices need CLX_BULK_UPDATE and a promise of 10,000.00 by 15 October with 10,000.00 applied on 14 October, when the handler clicks Record Promise and enters the invoice (or chooses an installment), the day of the promise, the promised date and the amount, then it is KEPT after the check of 15 October.
* (AC2) Given the user has CLX_WORK; several invoices need CLX_BULK_UPDATE and a promise with 4,000.00 applied in time, when the handler clicks Record Promise and enters the invoice (or chooses an installment), the day of the promise, the promised date and the amount, then it is PARTIALLY_KEPT.
* (AC3) Given the user has CLX_WORK; several invoices need CLX_BULK_UPDATE and a promise with nothing applied, when the handler clicks Record Promise and enters the invoice (or chooses an installment), the day of the promise, the promised date and the amount, then it is BROKEN, the AO is notified and the account is escalated to the team lead by the broken-promise rule.

* Persona: Collection Team Lead (maker, with CLX_SETUP); authoriser with MASTER_AUTHORIZE
* Function: An escalation rule says when an account is escalated automatically and to whom. It has a code, name, basis and threshold, optional filters (segment, sales unit, product line, outstanding range), the target level (TL, UH, Section Head or a named user), the reason, the SLA in hours, whether to notify, and effective dates.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Bases - aging from booking, aging from inception, no commitment by day N (no open promise), broken promises count, installment overdue days, amount over. (Fixed)
* (R2) Delivered rules, to be confirmed (CQ14) - broken promise to the team lead; 45 days from booking to the TL; 60th day from inception to the UH; installment overdue 15 days to the TL; and, from the thresholds of the minutes (45, 60 and 120 days), 120 days from booking to the Section Head (CLR-CL-34). (Configurable)
* (R3) The maker never authorises the rule. (Fixed)
* Check: Company or code missing. Message: "Enter the company and the rule code"
* Check: Threshold or SLA not positive. Message: "The threshold and the SLA hours must be positive"
* Check: USER target without user. Message: "Name the user who receives the escalations of this rule"
* Check: End before start. Message: "The rule cannot end before it becomes effective"
* Check: Amount range reversed. Message: "The amount range ends below its start"
* Check: Authoriser is the maker. Message: "A record cannot be authorized by the user who maintained it"

column4: Escalate accounts automatically
column6:
As a Collection Team Lead, I need to configure escalation rules based on aging, commitments and broken promises, so that overdue accounts are handled consistently.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.049 (p.18); BRCLXN.055 (p.20)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Escalation, FR-CL-051 Escalate accounts automatically
* Persona: System
* Function: The job CLX_ESCALATION runs every night at 23:00, after the promise check. For each active rule it finds the accounts that meet the rule and raises one escalation per rule, invoice and month, unless an escalation of that rule is still open for the account. It then closes open escalations whose invoices are fully collected.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One escalation per rule, invoice and month (one key), none while one of the rule is open. (Fixed)
* (R2) Schedule 23:00 Manila daily. (Configurable)
* (R3) Without a designated user the escalation waits in the stage queue; resolving the TL or UH of an account from the sales organisation waits for BDOI (CQ14). (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given at least one authorised, effective rule and an account 46 days from booking, when the job evaluates each rule against the open accounts, then it is escalated to the TL by the 45-day rule, once in the month.
* (AC2) Given at least one authorised, effective rule and a broken promise, when the job evaluates each rule against the open accounts, then it raises an escalation to the team lead the same night.
* (AC3) Given at least one authorised, effective rule and an escalated account that is paid in full, when the job evaluates each rule against the open accounts, then it is closed automatically at the next run.

*Out of scope / notes*

column4: Escalate accounts manually
column6:
As a Collection Handler, I need to escalate an account manually to the team lead or a designated authority, so that difficult or exceptional cases are addressed promptly beyond the automated rules.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.050 (p.18)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Escalation, FR-CL-052 Escalate accounts manually
* Persona: Collection user with CLX_ESCALATE
* Function: A collection user escalates one or more invoices to the team lead, the unit / section head or a designated user, whatever their automated status. BIBS groups the selected invoices by account (ARN) and raises one escalation per account, kind MANUAL, with the reason and remarks. The escalation follows the same workflow as an automatic one.

*Business rules*
* (R1) At most 500 invoices in one action. (Fixed)
* (R2) The invoices of one account are escalated together. (Fixed)
* (R3) The designated user must hold CLX_ESCALATION_HANDLE. (Fixed)
* Check: Level or user missing. Message: "Choose the level, and the user for a designated authority"
* Check: User cannot handle escalations. Message: "<user> does not handle escalations"
* Check: Invoice with nothing to collect. Message: "Invoice <no> has nothing to collect"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CLX_ESCALATE, when the user clicks Escalate Accounts and enters the invoice numbers, then escalating five invoices of two accounts raises two escalations.
* (AC2) Given the user has CLX_ESCALATE, when the user clicks Escalate Accounts and enters the invoice numbers, then a user without CLX_ESCALATE does not see Escalate Accounts.
* (AC3) Given the user has CLX_ESCALATE and an account already escalated by a rule, when the user clicks Escalate Accounts and enters the invoice numbers, then it can still be escalated by hand.

column4: Act on an escalation
column6:
As a Collection Team Lead, I need to configure escalation rules based on aging, commitments and broken promises, so that overdue accounts are handled consistently.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.049 (p.18); BRCLXN.050 (p.18)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.6 Escalation, FR-CL-053 Act on an escalation
* Persona: Team Lead, Unit Head, Section Head (CLX_ESCALATION_HANDLE); handler (resubmit)
* Function: The receiving level works its escalations from the Escalations inbox. It acknowledges an escalation (IN_ACTION), escalates it further to the unit / section head with a reason, returns it to the handler with an instruction, or resolves it with the resolution. A returned escalation is resubmitted by the handler once the instruction is done.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Stages and actions are those of workflow CLX_ESCALATION (section 5.1). (Fixed)
* (R2) Stage SLA from the rule; default 24 hours at WITH_TL and WITH_UH, 72 at IN_ACTION, 48 at RETURNED. (Configurable)
* Check: Resolve without resolution. Message: "Describe how the escalation was resolved"
* Check: Unknown action. Message: "'<action>' is not an escalation action"
* Check: Escalate further or return without reason. Message: "Select a reason for '<action>'"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CLX_ESCALATION_HANDLE (resubmit - CLX_WORK or CLX_ESCALATE), when the TL opens an escalation in WITH_TL and clicks Acknowledge, then a TL acknowledges and resolves an escalation with a resolution; it closes as RESOLVED.
* (AC2) Given the user has CLX_ESCALATION_HANDLE (resubmit - CLX_WORK or CLX_ESCALATE), when the TL opens an escalation in WITH_TL and clicks Acknowledge, then a TL cannot resolve without a resolution.
* (AC3) Given the user has CLX_ESCALATION_HANDLE (resubmit - CLX_WORK or CLX_ESCALATE) and a returned escalation, when the TL opens an escalation in WITH_TL and clicks Acknowledge, then it shows in the handler's Escalations and can be resubmitted.

column4: Generate billing statements per billing cycle
column6:
As Operations Cashiering (the Operations billing user), I need to generate and send billing statements per billing cycle of multi-year and installment policies, so that billing and commissions are handled correctly, while the Collection Handler sees the statements.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLXN.058 (p.21); Minutes of 27-Apr-2026 on BRD 58 (p.1)
* FRS: FRS BRD-04 Collections v2.1 (02_BIBS_FRS_BRD-04_Collections_v2.1.docx), section 4.7 Billing statements, FR-CL-060 Generate billing statements per billing cycle
* Persona: Operations billing user (Accounting / Operations; proposed the Cashiering Team Leader / Head, CLX_SOA_ISSUE); Collection user (view)
* Function: BIBS generates a statement of account (SOA) for a billing cycle of a live installment plan. The SOA lists the installment of the cycle (CURRENT) with its coverage period and every earlier installment still unpaid (ARREARS), the payments allocated on the day (FR-CL-041) and the amount due. It is numbered SOA-yyyy-n and rendered to PDF from the template CLX_SOA, whose version is recorded.

*Business rules*
* (R1) One live SOA per plan and billing cycle. (Fixed)
* (R2) Amounts follow the installment of the policy period; multi-year and installment policies are supported. (Fixed)
* (R3) Layout, recipient and numbering are drafts until BDOI answers CQ18 and provides the sample SOA annex announced in the minutes. (Configurable)
* (R4) Only CLX_SOA_ISSUE holders generate statements; the Collections roles view them (minutes p.1; CLR-CL-32). (Configurable)
* (R5) No new user profile: the permission is granted to an existing Operations profile named by BDOI. (Fixed)
* Check: Collections user starts a billing run or generates a statement. Message: "You are not permitted to perform this action"
* Check: Cycle already billed. Message: "Cycle <n> of <plan> is billed by <SOA>"
* Check: Plan cancelled. Message: "Plan <no> is cancelled"
* Check: Period end before start. Message: "The period ends before it starts"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CLX_SOA_ISSUE (generate) or CLX_VIEW (view); the plan is ACTIVE and the three-year seed account with an annual plan, when the Operations billing user opens Billing Statements and clicks Billing Run, entering the due period, then BIBS produces an SOA for each of its three billing cycles.
* (AC2) Given the user has CLX_SOA_ISSUE (generate) or CLX_VIEW (view); the plan is ACTIVE and a second SOA for a billed cycle, when the Operations billing user opens Billing Statements and clicks Billing Run, entering the due period, then it is refused until the first is cancelled.
* (AC3) Given the user has CLX_SOA_ISSUE (generate) or CLX_VIEW (view); the plan is ACTIVE, when the Operations billing user opens Billing Statements and clicks Billing Run, entering the due period, then the SOA shows the coverage period of the installment and any unpaid earlier installment as arrears.
* (AC4) Given the user has CLX_SOA_ISSUE (generate) or CLX_VIEW (view); the plan is ACTIVE, when the Operations billing user opens Billing Statements and clicks Billing Run, entering the due period, then a Collection Handler sees the statements of a plan and downloads the PDF, but has no Billing Run or Generate SOA action.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-CL-32 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Billing statements generated by Operations (BRCLXN.058, 060; FR-CL-060 to 062; WT-D). Proposed: The Operations billing user, with the new permission CLX_SOA_ISSUE, runs the billing, generates, sends and cancels the statements; the proposed holder is the Cashiering Team Leader / Head, an existing Operations profile. The Collection Handlers and Team Leads see the statements, their lines and e-mails and download the PDF, read only; they keep the installment plans (FR-CL-040). In the screenshots of WT-D steps 2 to 4 and of the Billing Statements and Statement of Account screens the statement is generated and sent by the seed user Clara Collection Handler; under this rule the Operations billing user does these steps and is shown as Generated By. Decision requested: Confirm that Operations generates and sends the statements and name the existing Operations profile that holds CLX_SOA_ISSUE (proposed: the Cashiering Team Leader / Head); confirm that the Collections roles only view them; provide the sample SOA annex (CQ18).

column4: View the list of unapplied payments as of today

* Persona: Collection Handler; Unapplied Payment Handler; Marketing AO; Cashiering (read)
* Function: The Unapplied Payments screen lists the payments Cashiering could not apply, with an open balance as of today, read live from Cashiering. Each row shows the payment date and age (today less the payment date), the payment file (upload batch reference), transaction no., amount and unapplied balance, payment type, payor, bank code, check no., payor reference, the matched client or invoice, the Cashiering tab ("processing stage") and the status of the Cashiering disposition or collector request.

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CLX_VIEW and a payment received today and not matched, when the user opens Unapplied Payments, then it appears on Awaiting Disposition with age 0.
* (AC2) Given the user has CLX_VIEW and a payment matched to an invoice, when the user opens Unapplied Payments, then it shows the invoice's assured, AO and PR balance.

column4: Validate the invoice of "for application to invoice"

* Persona: System
* Function: When the chosen disposition requires an invoice ("For application to invoice"), the invoice number is mandatory, must match the pattern CLX_INVOICE_NO_PATTERN and must exist in the invoice ledger of the company. The form checks the pattern before sending and the server checks all three; the disposition cannot be submitted otherwise.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Pattern default ^(I\d(8)/BI-.+)$ - the EBIX format I and 8 digits, or the BIBS format BI-...; whether EBIX numbers are still accepted after go-live is open (CQ13). (Configurable)
* (R2) The invoice must exist in the BIBS invoice ledger. (Fixed)
* Check: Invoice blank. Message: "Enter the invoice number to apply the payment to"
* Check: Invoice not in the pattern. Message: "Invoice number <no> does not have the expected format (<pattern>)"
* Check: Invoice not in the ledger. Message: "Invoice <no> is not in the invoice ledger"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the disposition value is set to require an invoice (Disposition Rules) and a "For application to invoice" disposition without an invoice number, when the handler enters the invoice number, then it is refused with CLX_INVOICE_REQUIRED.
* (AC2) Given the disposition value is set to require an invoice (Disposition Rules), when the handler enters the invoice number, then the invoice number I1234567 (7 digits) is refused with CLX_INVOICE_FORMAT.
* (AC3) Given the disposition value is set to require an invoice (Disposition Rules) and a well-formed invoice number that is not booked, when the handler enters the invoice number, then it is refused with CLX_INVOICE_UNKNOWN.

column4: Maintain the reported date
column6:

* Persona: Claims Officer / Assistant (at recording); BCL_STATUS_UPDATE holder (correction)
* Function: The reported date is the only operational date users maintain on a claim. It is entered at recording and is the start of every claim age (FR-CM-053). Other dates (status changes, closure, updates) are system time stamps. A correction of the reported date on an open claim needs BCL_STATUS_UPDATE and a reason, and is kept in the history.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The reported date is between the loss date and today. (Fixed)

* Check: Date outside the allowed range. Message: "The reported date must be between the loss date and today"
* Check: Correction on a closed claim. Message: "The reported date of a closed claim cannot change"

* (AC3) Given the claim is open (phase NEW, IN_PROGRESS or TEMP_CLOSED) for a correction, when the user clicks Correct Reported Date on the Details tab, then a Claims Officer without BCL_STATUS_UPDATE cannot correct the date after recording.

column4: Validate the claim against the latest cover version and flag a newer version
column6:
As a Claims Officer / Claims Assistant, I need every claim validated against the latest endorsement or cover version, with the cover number and version shown and a newer version flagged, while the policy data stays view-only, so that the claim is checked against current terms.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLM.039 (p.7-8); BRCLM.003 (p.16; p.31)
* FRS: FRS BRD-07 Claims v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-07_Claims_v1.1.docx), section 4.2 Cover, policy and premium, FR-CM-015 Validate the claim against the latest cover version and flag a newer version
* Persona: Claims user; System
* Function: Claims validation always uses the latest policy endorsement or cover version (minutes of 27-Apr-2026). When the claim is recorded, BIBS takes the latest booked version of the policy year - all booked endorsements - and the premium check, the location picker and the authorization code use it. The claim displays the cover number and version used, as "Cover v<n> (<endorsement no.>)", and the endorsements effective after the loss date are marked on the cover panel.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Version used = the latest booked version of the policy year at the time of the validation (minutes of 27-Apr-2026, BR 39); endorsements effective after the loss date are marked (CLR-CM-14). (Fixed)
* (R2) Location lists are not versioned per endorsement until CLQ02 is answered. (Fixed)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the claim is recorded and a claim recorded on a cover with two booked endorsements, when BIBS takes the latest booked version at recording and validates the claim against it, then it is validated against version 2 and shows the cover number and version used.
* (AC2) Given the claim is recorded, when BIBS takes the latest booked version at recording and validates the claim against it, then an endorsement booked after the loss date is used for the validation and is marked as effective after the loss date.
* (AC3) Given the claim is recorded, when BIBS takes the latest booked version at recording and validates the claim against it, then after an endorsement of the policy year is booked, the claim shows "Newer cover version".
* (AC4) Given the claim is recorded, when BIBS takes the latest booked version at recording and validates the claim against it, then the cover panel of the claim has no edit action.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-CM-14 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Latest cover version (BRCLM.039; FR-CM-015). Proposed: Every validation of a claim uses the latest booked version of the policy year, including endorsements effective after the loss date, which are marked on the cover panel. Version 1.0 used the version in force at the loss date. Decision requested: Confirm that an endorsement effective after the loss date (for example a location added later) is used for the validation of the claim (CLQ02).

column4: Check premium payment and control the claims authorization code
column6:
As a Claims Officer / Claims Assistant, I need BIBS to identify the unpaid invoices of the cover and disable the claims authorization code while the premium is unpaid, so that no claim is authorised on unpaid premium.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCLM.001 (p.15; p.31); NFR 15.05 (p.41)
* FRS: FRS BRD-07 Claims v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-07_Claims_v1.1.docx), section 4.2 Cover, policy and premium, FR-CM-016 Check premium payment and control the claims authorization code
* Persona: System; Claims Officer, TL, TH (BCL_AUTHORIZE)
* Function: BIBS identifies unpaid invoices of the cover. It reads the invoices of the ARN and policy year (originals, endorsements and cancellations; cancelled invoices excluded) from the invoice ledger with their payment status. The result is PAID, UNPAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, DIRECT_PAYMENT or NO_INVOICE, with the list of unpaid invoices and their balances.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Code only when the premium check is PAID. (Fixed)
* (R2) Direct-payment accounts: ALLOW, CONFIRM (evidence attached) or BLOCK; default CONFIRM. (Configurable)
* (R3) Cancelled invoices are excluded from the check. (Fixed)
* (R4) The meaning and use of the code, and any TL / TH override, are confirmed under CLQ01. (Configurable)
* Check: Code requested while premium is unpaid. Message: "The premium of <ARN> <policy year> is not fully paid. The authorization code cannot be generated"
* Check: Direct payment without evidence. Message: "Attach the insurer's payment evidence first"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the claim is recorded, when BIBS runs the premium check when the claim is recorded and shows the result on the cover card, then on a cover with one unpaid endorsement invoice, the claim shows "Unpaid premium" with the invoice and its balance, and the code cannot be generated.
* (AC2) Given the claim is recorded, when BIBS runs the premium check when the claim is recorded and shows the result on the cover card, then after the invoice is paid in Cashiering, the claim shows PAID and the code can be generated.
* (AC3) Given the claim is recorded and a cancelled unpaid invoice, when BIBS runs the premium check when the claim is recorded and shows the result on the cover card, then it does not block the code.
* (AC4) Given the claim is recorded, when BIBS runs the premium check when the claim is recorded and shows the result on the cover card, then the premium check answers within 5 seconds (NFR 15.05).

column4: Link several insured locations to one claim

As a Claims Officer / Claims Assistant, I need to link several insured locations of the cover to one claim - mainly for non-motor products, grouped per client and per risk - so that a multi-location loss stays one claim and no location outside the cover is claimed.

* Persona: Claims user (BCL_RECORD)
* Function: A claim can reference more than one insured location of its cover. This applies mainly to non-motor products (property, marine cargo); a motor claim is tied to the insured unit (minutes of 27-Apr-2026, BR 37). Locations are grouped per client and per risk and are chosen only from the location list of the cover (risk items of kind location); a location that the policy does not cover cannot be claimed; BIBS stores each with its address, city, province and normalised location key. The claim keeps one claim number whatever the number of locations. Each linked location shows its insurer location references (FR-CM-023).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only locations of the claim's cover may be linked. (Fixed)
* (R2) A location is linked once per claim. (Fixed)
* (R3) One claim reference regardless of the number of locations (AC4). (Fixed)

* Check: Location already linked. Message: "Location <item> is already on this claim"

* (AC2) Given the cover has at least one insured location, when on Record Claim, or on the Locations tab, the user opens the location picker, then a location of another account, or one not on the cover, cannot be linked.
* (AC3) Given the cover has at least one insured location and each linked location, when on Record Claim, or on the Locations tab, the user opens the location picker, then it is viewable on the Locations tab with its address.

BIBS proposes the insurers and shares from the invoice shares of the cover.

column4: Close a claim temporarily or permanently and reopen it

* Persona: Claims Officer (temporary closure); Team Lead, Team Head (permanent closure); Team Head, Unit Head (reopen)
* Function: Temporary closure uses the statuses of phase TEMP_CLOSED: 17 "Temporary Closed Claim - Non-submission of Documents" and 18 "Temporary Closed Claim - with Offer". The claim stays outstanding and ageing continues; any permitted user resumes it by setting an in-progress status.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Officers tag temporary closures; TL / TH close permanently; TH / UH reopen (to confirm, CLQ06). (Configurable)
* (R2) A permanent closure needs the settlement amount and date required by the type. (Fixed)
* (R3) Temporarily closed claims stay in the outstanding reports. (Configurable)

* (AC2) Given the claim is open (closure) or CLOSED (reopen) and a claim closed with "Closed - Denied", when the officer sets status 17 or 18; BIBS marks the claim temporarily closed, then it appears in the Closed tab and no longer ages.

* Persona: Claims / Risk user (BCL_REPORT_VIEW)
* Function: The report shows, per location key, city and province, the number of claims, paid and outstanding amounts over a period, and flags a location "claims-prone" when it has at least the threshold number of claims in the look-back years. * Function: A daily job opens a renewal cycle for each programme flagged for renewal whose line expires in the lead time, composes the RA from the template with the key programme details, and sends it to the programme's HR contacts that receive RAs. Reminders follow at set days while no feedback is recorded; each carries a feedback request with a link to the client portal.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Lead time 135 days before expiry (default, TAT annex); the BRD example is 180 days (EBQ02). (Configurable)

* (R3) Only programmes flagged for renewal; who sets the flag is confirmed under EBQ03. (Fixed)
* (R4) EB lines are excluded from the general Renewal lists (decision D3). (Fixed)
* Check: Manual send to an ineligible programme. Message: "Programme <no.> is not flagged for renewal"

* (AC1) Given the programme is flagged for renewal and has at least one HR contact receiving RAs and a programme expiring in 135 days, when the job runs daily at 06:00 PHT, then it receives the RA and moves to RA_SENT.
* (AC2) Given the programme is flagged for renewal and has at least one HR contact receiving RAs and a programme without the renewal flag, when the job runs daily at 06:00 PHT, then it receives no RA.

column4: Trigger approval when a value threshold is met
column6:
As BDOI Management, I need an approval when a transaction meets or exceeds a defined value threshold (total sum insured or premium), so that large programmes are approved at the right level.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID-016 (p.23)
* FRS: FRS BRD-08 Employee Benefits v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-08_Employee_Benefits_v1.1.docx), section 4.5 Proposals, comparative, approvals and client decision, FR-EB-042 Trigger approval when a value threshold is met
* Persona: System; BDOI Management (EB_THRESHOLD_APPROVE)
* Function: Threshold rules define, per benefit line or all lines, a measure (TSI or annual premium), an amount and currency, the approver permission and level, and effective dates. BIBS evaluates them on the recommended proposal when the comparative is signed off, and again on client confirmation. When a rule is met, the cycle waits in THRESHOLD_APPROVAL; approvers are notified and see the item in My Approvals, and placement is blocked until approval. Administrators maintain the rules with maker-checker.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Seed values TSI >= 500M and premium >= 20M are examples; BDOI gives the values and levels (EBQ11). (Configurable)
* (R2) The AO of the cycle never approves the threshold. (Fixed)
* Check: Placement triggered while approval pending. Message: "Cycle <no.> waits for the threshold approval"
* Check: Rule amount not positive. Message: "Enter an amount greater than zero"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given a comparative is signed off or the client confirms, when BIBS evaluates the rules; a rule matches, then a comparative with a recommended annual premium above the rule amount waits for Management approval.
* (AC2) Given a comparative is signed off or the client confirms, when BIBS evaluates the rules; a rule matches, then Placement cannot be triggered before the threshold approval.
* (AC3) Given a comparative is signed off or the client confirms, when BIBS evaluates the rules; a rule matches, then a rule changed by the administrator applies after authorisation without a change to the system.

column6:
As a BDO Insure Contact Center Agent, I need to log and track customer inquiries in BIBS instead of SharePoint, so that every inquiry is handled to closure; the e-mail of 13-Feb-2026 deferred this to its own requirement document, which is the Case Management Addendum (rows BRCSFCM below).

*Background*

* Persona: Contact Center Agent (CSF_CASE_CREATE)
* Function: Every inquiry, whatever the channel (phone, e-mail, e-mail through the BDO website), is logged as a case. The agent clicks Log Case on the Servicing View of the client; the dialog takes the client and, where the inquiry is about a policy, the account from the Servicing View. The agent selects the channel, the case type, the nature of transaction, the product type, the market segment and the fulfilment unit from the case lists of values (FR-CSF-061), enters the subject and the description of the request, and either resolves the case at once or submits it to the fulfilment unit.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Case IDs are CASE-yyyy-nnnnnn, numbered by year. (Configurable)
* (R2) Mandatory fields - channel, case type, nature of transaction, product type, market segment and fulfilment unit - come from the case lists of values. (Fixed)
* (R3) Duplicate rule - one open case per client, account and nature of transaction (CLR-CSF-11). (Configurable)
* (R4) The market segment is proposed from the account and the fulfilment unit from the routing table; the agent may change both. (Configurable)
* Check: Mandatory field blank. Message: "Complete the mandatory fields - <fields>"
* Check: Open case for the same transaction. Message: "Case <Case ID> is already open for this client, account and nature of transaction. Add a note to it instead"
* Check: Resolve and Close without resolution. Message: "Enter the resolution given to the client"
* Check: Caller not a client without name or contact. Message: "Enter the caller's name and a contact number or e-mail"
* Check: Inactive list value. Message: "The value <value> is no longer in use. Select another value"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has CSF_CASE_CREATE and for a client case: the client's Servicing View is open and a case submitted with all mandatory fields, when the agent clicks Log Case, then it gets a unique Case ID, is linked to the client and the account and shows in the queue of the fulfilment unit with the status Open - With Fulfillment Unit.

* (AC3) Given the user has CSF_CASE_CREATE and for a client case: the client's Servicing View is open, when the agent clicks Log Case, then a second case for the same client, account and nature of transaction is refused while the first is open, and the open case is named.

* (AC5) Given the user has CSF_CASE_CREATE and for a client case: the client's Servicing View is open, when the agent clicks Log Case, then the members of the fulfilment unit receive the notification with the Case ID and the policy number.
* (AC6) Given the user has CSF_CASE_CREATE and for a client case: the client's Servicing View is open and a case resolved on the call, when the agent clicks Log Case, then it is created with the status Closed by CSR and its resolution.

column6:

* Persona: Contact Center Agent; Contact Center Supervisor (CSF_CASE_SUPERVISE)
* Function: The agent selects the case type from the predefined list - Inquiry, Request, Request (1-day), Problem, Complaint, Follow-up, Commendation. * (R2) Turnaround time in working days from the creation of the case, on the BIBS holiday calendar (CLR-CSF-09). (Configurable)
* (R3) Only CSF_CASE_SUPERVISE changes the category of a submitted case; a reason is mandatory. (Fixed)
* (R4) A new case type recomputes the due date from the creation time, not from the change. (Fixed)

* (AC3) Given for a change: the case is open and the user has CSF_CASE_SUPERVISE, when the agent selects the case type when logging the case; BIBS shows its turnaround time and the due date, then changing an Inquiry to a Complaint moves the due date to 6 working days from the creation and records the old and new type.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Allowed transitions are those of section 5.3. (Fixed)
* (R2) Closed by Fulfillment Unit and Closed by CSR are final; a follow-up is a new linked case (FR-CSF-058). (Fixed)
* (R3) Status labels and status groups are maintained; the transitions are not. (Configurable)

* (AC2) Given the step is due in BIBS, when a user takes an action on the case (submit, return, request CSR action, re-endorse, close), then an attempt to return a case that is Closed by CSR is refused.
* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS and every status change, when a user takes an action on the case (submit, return, request CSR action, re-endorse, close), then it is listed in the History tab with the time and the user.

* Persona: System
* Function: BIBS logs every case action automatically - creation, updates of fields, status changes, priority changes, category changes, reassignments, escalations, notes and attachments - each with the from value, the to value, the user, the action and the date and time. column4: Track case ageing and SLA thresholds
column6:

*Background*

* Persona: System; Contact Center Supervisor
* Function: BIBS computes the age of every case from its creation time and its SLA status against the turnaround time of its case type - Within TAT, Approaching breach (from the near-breach threshold) and Breached. The SLA indicator shows on the case header, on each queue row and on the supervisor dashboard.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Ageing runs from the creation time; the clock does not stop while the case waits for the client (CLR-CSF-09). (Configurable)
* (R2) Near-breach threshold - 1 working day before the due date (default). (Configurable)
* (R3) Automatic escalation on breach per case type (default on). (Configurable)
* (R4) Check interval 15 minutes (default). (Configurable)

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the step is due in BIBS, when a scheduled check runs every 15 minutes (default) on the open cases, then a case one working day before its due date shows Approaching breach and the four recipients are notified once.

* (AC3) Given the step is due in BIBS and a breached Complaint, when a scheduled check runs every 15 minutes (default) on the open cases, then it is escalated automatically with the reason Past TAT.
* (AC4) Given the step is due in BIBS, when a scheduled check runs every 15 minutes (default) on the open cases, then the age of a case is counted from its creation time.

column4: Route, resolve and return a case by the Fulfilment Unit
column6:
As a Fulfilment Unit, I need to receive the logged case, maintain its resolution and close it, or return it to the contact centre when it has an error or needs more handling, so that each case is resolved by the unit that owns it.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRCSFCM.012 (p.8); Envisioned process IV.6 (p.4); Current process III.6 (p.4)
* FRS: FRS BRD-09 Customer Servicing Facility v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-09_Customer_Servicing_Facility_v1.1.docx), section 4.6 Case management, FR-CSF-060 Route, resolve and return a case by the Fulfilment Unit
* Persona: Fulfilment Unit (CSF_CASE_FULFIL); System
* Function: BIBS routes each submitted case to the fulfilment unit selected on the case. The fulfilment unit is proposed from a routing table maintained by Contact Center Management - case type, market segment and nature of transaction to fulfilment unit - so routing is system-driven; the account officer and the unit of the account receive a copy of the notification, so the BU/AO ownership of the account is kept.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Routing table - case type, market segment and nature of transaction to fulfilment unit and escalation group. (Configurable)
* (R2) Each fulfilment unit lists its member users; a user may belong to several units. (Configurable)
* (R3) Return reasons are maintained. (Configurable)
* (R4) A member sees only the cases of his fulfilment units. (Fixed)
* Check: Resolve without resolution. Message: "Enter the resolution given to the client"
* Check: Return without reason. Message: "Select the return reason"
* Check: Case of another fulfilment unit. Message: "You are not permitted to perform this action"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user is a member of the fulfilment unit of the case and has CSF_CASE_FULFIL and a Request case for a Consumer 1 Motor account, when the case arrives in the Fulfilment Unit Queue with the status Open - With Fulfillment Unit, then it is proposed to the fulfilment unit of the routing table and shows in that unit's queue.
* (AC2) Given the user is a member of the fulfilment unit of the case and has CSF_CASE_FULFIL, when the case arrives in the Fulfilment Unit Queue with the status Open - With Fulfillment Unit, then a member of the fulfilment unit resolves and closes the case; the agent is notified and the case shows Closed by Fulfillment Unit.
* (AC3) Given the user is a member of the fulfilment unit of the case and has CSF_CASE_FULFIL and a returned case, when the case arrives in the Fulfilment Unit Queue with the status Open - With Fulfillment Unit, then it shows Open - Returned to Agent in the agent's Returned to Me queue with the reason.
* (AC4) Given the user is a member of the fulfilment unit of the case and has CSF_CASE_FULFIL, when the case arrives in the Fulfilment Unit Queue with the status Open - With Fulfillment Unit, then a member of another fulfilment unit cannot see the case.

column4: Maintain the case lists of values and the routing table
column6:
As Contact Center Management, I need the case channels, case types with turnaround times, natures of transaction, product types, market segments and fulfilment units maintained as lists, so that cases are categorised, routed and reported consistently.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: Lists of values I-VI (p.11-17); Envisioned process IV.2, IV.5 (p.4); BRCSFCM.002 (p.5)
* FRS: FRS BRD-09 Customer Servicing Facility v1.1 (BIBS_FRS_BRD-09_Customer_Servicing_Facility_v1.1.docx), section 4.6 Case management, FR-CSF-061 Maintain the case lists of values and the routing table
* Persona: System Administrator, at the request of Contact Center Management
* Function: The case lists of values of the addendum are loaded at go-live and maintained without a release - Channel (3 values), Case Type with its turnaround time (7), Nature of Transaction (125), Product Type (51), Market Segment (33) and Fulfillment Unit (53) - together with the lists that the FRs add - case priority, escalation reason, return reason, closure reason and case status labels. A value is deactivated, not deleted, so that existing cases keep it.

*Business rules*
* (R1) List values are deactivated, never deleted, once used on a case. (Fixed)
* (R2) Each list value may carry the corresponding BIBS market segment or product line (CLR-CSF-10). (Configurable)
* Check: Duplicate value in a list. Message: "The value <value> already exists in the list"
* Check: Turnaround time blank or not a whole number. Message: "Enter the turnaround time in whole working days"
* Check: Routing row duplicate. Message: "A routing row already exists for this case type, market segment and nature of transaction"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the user has LOV_MANAGE (lists) or CSF_CASE_ROUTING (routing table), when Contact Center Management sends the change; the System Administrator adds, changes or deactivates the value or the routing row, then the Log Case dialog offers the 3 channels, 7 case types, 125 natures of transaction, 51 product types, 33 market segments and 53 fulfilment units of the addendum.
* (AC2) Given the user has LOV_MANAGE (lists) or CSF_CASE_ROUTING (routing table) and a deactivated nature of transaction, when Contact Center Management sends the change; the System Administrator adds, changes or deactivates the value or the routing row, then it is no longer offered and still shows on the cases that used it.
* (AC3) Given the user has LOV_MANAGE (lists) or CSF_CASE_ROUTING (routing table), when Contact Center Management sends the change; the System Administrator adds, changes or deactivates the value or the routing row, then a routing row added for a case type and market segment proposes its fulfilment unit on the next case logged.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-CSF-06 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Case management (CSF-EM10). Proposed: Superseded. Case management is specified in section 4.6 (FR-CSF-050 to 061) from the signed Case Management Addendum. Decision requested: None; the delivery drop is CLR-CSF-07.
* CLR-CSF-10 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Fulfilment units, routing and lists (BRCSFCM.012, p.4, p.14-17; CSQ19). Proposed: The case market segments, product types and fulfilment units are the contact centre's own lists, each value optionally linked to the BIBS market segment or product line. The fulfilment unit is proposed from a routing table of case type, market segment and nature of transaction; the account officer of the account receives a copy. Fulfilment unit users get the CSF_FULFILMENT role with the membership of their units through User Access requests. Decision requested: Confirm the lists as CSF lists, provide the members and escalation group of each unit and the first routing table.
* CLR-CR-03 (umbrella FRS) - open, for BDOI confirmation: CSF case resolution (CORE-16.06)
